status: PROPOSED (2026-10-21 UTC): the master corpus the old-vs-new comparison's new arm and the nested ladder are cut from. Built by scripts/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/build_master_ladder.py once its sessions exist; no session exists yet and nothing is generated by this file.
size_measure: unique supervised assistant tokens (aadistill.data.dataset.final_assistant_loss_mask: <think>, reasoning, </think>, answer, <|im_end|>)
_shares: primary 0.68 / supporting 0.32: every P10.2 primary axis is present (interactive included, unlike the Stage-0 pilot which had 13 episodes), and the supporting share keeps verified math and evidence reading, which eval-set-1 reports and which the primary tasks lean on. The mixture is HELD FIXED across rungs and arms of the new scheme; it is not the factor under study (the Stage-0 mixture ratio stays deferred). A maintainer decision.

supporting.reading_verified.reuse: existing teacher targets whose selected answer is span-verified; no new generation

family_key: generator_id/family_id for procedural items; source id for external items
_reserve: the in-training validation tail (>= 16 blocks for aadistill.data.ladder.ladder_blocks), composition-matched and outside every rung

primary.trace_check: episodes: every action legal (invalid_actions = 0) on environment replay; static: not_assessed

acceptance.selection: lowest accepted candidate index; never by length
acceptance.length_rule: a session whose render exceeds block_len is EXCLUDED and counted, never cut (P17); the generation allowance is block_len - rendered prompt - 8 so a trace that cannot be trained is stopped as length_limited instead of paid for to 16k

supporting.math_verified._proxy: gsm8k_train and math_train have no teacher record yet; corpus_v2's gsm8k (same source) and openmath (harder, and its answer key is noisy) bracket them

candidate_policy: up to 2 candidates per task, the second only when the first is rejected; every candidate recorded. Yield is planned at the measured n = 1 rate per generated token, which a retry does not change.
_yield: accepted supervised tokens per generated token, measured per stratum from Stage-0 teacher_cal (<= 8,192 rendered, verified) and corpus_v2 (verified under the contract); replaced by the generation run's own figure
_new_arm_rendered_per_supervised: share-weighted rendered/supervised from the dry run (fluid traces 1.055) and the audit's selected corpus_v2 sessions (gsm8k 1.068, openmath 1.025, rag 1.396, multihop 2.371); a planning figure

durability._network_volume_price: the recorded basis of the retired volumes (runs/netvol_20261019_051206/closeout/outcome.json)
